messages.inviteEmailFailed: The invitation was created but the email could not be sent.

view.label: View only
view.description: Status, milestones, tasks and deliverables. No comments, edits or uploads.

comment.label: View + comment
comment.description: Comment, approve or reject and attach files to comments. Cannot create tasks.

contributor.label: Full contributor
contributor.description: Everything above, plus create and edit tasks, change status and upload attachments.

view_only.name: View Only
view_only.description: Stakeholders who just need visibility: status and deliverables, no editing.

standard_contact.name: Standard Contact
standard_contact.description: The default for most client contacts: can comment, approve or reject and attach files.

full_partner.name: Full Partner
full_partner.description: Hands-on collaborators: can create and edit tasks and upload attachments.

assignProjects.helper: Pick which of {{company}}’s projects {{name}} can access, and their permission level on each. A project can be assigned to many company users.
assignProjects.noProjectsDescription: Assign a project to this company first, then come back to give this user access. Permission templates need at least one project to apply to.

assignProjects.templatesTitle: Apply a template (sets every project below to that level)
